description: Search official Proa Rust framework documentation by a case-insensitive phrase. Use this to find current APIs, render patterns, RSJS guidance, and deployment instructions. Returns titles, routes, Markdown URLs, and a pagination cursor; call get_doc with a returned path for the complete page.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a preceding search with the same q.

limit.description: Maximum results per page; defaults to 10.

q.description: Phrase to find in document titles, descriptions, or Markdown.

name: search_docs

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when the result set is complete.
